# OpenScreenShot

> Free, open-source full page screenshot extension for Chrome — entire-scrolling-page, region, and visible-area screenshots with a built-in annotation editor and export to PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF. 100% local and private: works fully offline, screenshots never leave the device. MIT licensed.

- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hdabbojjccojlapnfjpdppcpfcnhgmdp
- Source: https://github.com/pghqdev/OpenScreenShot

## Docs

- [Overview (markdown)](https://openscreenshot.app/index.md): features, install, and agent/CLI usage in one page
- [Documentation](https://openscreenshot.app/docs/): user guide for capture modes, annotation, and export
- [Roadmap](https://openscreenshot.app/roadmap/): public roadmap
- [Support](https://openscreenshot.app/support/): help and contact

## Agents & CLI

- [capture-screenshot skill](https://openscreenshot.app/skills/capture-screenshot.md): agent skill for scripting screenshots via the openscreenshot-mcp CLI/MCP server
- [API catalog](https://openscreenshot.app/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 machine-readable service catalog

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://github.com/pghqdev/OpenScreenShot/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): no data collection, all processing local
- [License](https://github.com/pghqdev/OpenScreenShot/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
